entries.name: Standard ammo
entries.summary: Plain ammunition with no special properties.

entries.name: Armor-piercing ammo
entries.summary: Armor that is penetrated loses 2 SP instead of 1. Standard for grenades and explosives.

entries.name: Biotoxin ammo
entries.summary: No damage: a fleshy target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 15) and on a failure takes 3d6 ignoring armor (armor is not damaged).

entries.name: EMP ammo
entries.summary: No damage: the target makes a Cybertech check (DV 15); on a failure the GM picks two implants or electronic items and they shut down for 1 minute.

entries.name: Expansive ammo
entries.summary: A hit deals the Foreign Object critical injury. If the hit also caused a critical injury, the victim rolls the table again until they get one more different injury; the second and later ones deal no bonus damage.

entries.name: Flashbang ammo
entries.summary: No damage: the target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 15); on a failure they suffer Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear for a minute with no bonus damage.

entries.name: Incendiary ammo
entries.usable_with: Arrows, cartridges, grenades, slugs and shot
entries.summary: Penetrating armor sets the target on fire: 2 HP ignoring armor at the end of each of their turns until they spend an action putting it out. Does not stack.

entries.name: Poison ammo
entries.summary: No damage: a fleshy target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 13) and on a failure takes 2d6 ignoring armor (armor is not damaged).

entries.name: Rubber ammo
entries.summary: Damage cannot cause critical injuries, does not damage armor and cannot take HP below 1. Standard for exotic weapons.

entries.name: Sleep ammo
entries.summary: No damage: a fleshy target makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 13); on a failure they fall unconscious for 1 minute (damage or another's action wakes them).

entries.name: Smart ammo
entries.summary: Needs the Tactical Sight implant. A single shot that misses by 4 or less gets a second chance: roll 1d10 + 10 instead of STAT + skill + 1d10 (Luck can be added, the target may still dodge).

entries.name: Smoke ammo
entries.summary: No damage: on impact a 10×10 cloud of smoke for 1 minute, −4 to actions the smoke hinders.

entries.name: Tear gas
entries.summary: No damage: a target with eyes makes a Resist Torture/Drugs check (DV 13); on a failure they suffer Damaged Eye for a minute with no bonus damage.
